# Task XXIV {.unnumbered}

IETS Task XXIV **Process Integration for Industry Decarbonization** (2025–2027) builds a shared, documented database of ex-ante models of industrial processes, decarbonization technologies and energy systems. This part describes:

* the [Task](../00-TaskDescription.qmd): context, objectives, activities, deliverables and participants;
* the [rules for participating and sharing models](../01-ParticipationRules.qmd): joining the Task, the model template, confidentiality layers and intellectual property;
* [how to use this database](../02-HowToUseThisDatabase.qmd);
* the [annual interim Task report to SFOE](../03-AnnualInterimReport.qmd): the report on the first year of the Task, with its bibliographic information.
